summary: Install-time host/identity exfiltration via fake mkrf_conf extension to oastify.com
details: The gem declares ext/mkrf_conf.rb as a native extension, which RubyGems auto-executes during `gem install`. The script contains no build logic; instead it collects installer-side data (hostname, login user, cwd, home directory, and the contents of /etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, /etc/resolv.conf), serializes it as JSON, opens a TLS connection to the hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain g1im618xdjpuonmkxq16mr33quwlm9cx1.oastify.com:443, and POSTs the payload. A sentinel file.installed is then written. The extension-script naming is used solely to trigger auto-execution on install; no Rakefile is generated and no compilation occurs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
